# Match

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A condition tree (#33).

Each node is an object with exactly one key: `all`, `any`, `not`,
`criterion` or `ref`.

Appears at: `/rule_sets/rules/match`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/all`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/all/all`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/all/all/not`, `/rule_sets/rules/match/all/all/any`, and more.

## Variants

### `all`

Matches when every child matches. Needs at least one child.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | array of [`Match`](match.md) | yes |  | at least 1 items | 1.0.0 |  |

### `any`

Matches when any child matches. Needs at least one child.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `any` | array of [`Match`](match.md) | yes |  | at least 1 items | 1.0.0 |  |

### `not`

Matches when the child does not.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `not` | [`Match`](match.md) | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 |  |

### `criterion`

One test of one fact.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `criterion` | [`Criterion`](criterion.md) | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 |  |

### `ref`

A reference to a reusable match fragment or application definition
in a library (#37), by ID and an optional version pin. A policy
document that is evaluated never holds one: the hierarchy replaces
every reference with the tree it names when it builds the effective
policy, and validation rejects one that is left (`unresolved_ref`).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | [`LibraryRef`](library-ref.md) | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 |  |
